The AI Visibility Audit

Six deliverables. One clear picture of how AI sees you.

We score how AI sees your brand and how you stack up against your competitors. Then we give you the tools and the plan to close the gap.

Authority score

How much AI trusts you, based on who credible third parties say you are: press, podcasts, partners, directories and reviews.

Positioning sentiment

How AI describes you when it does mention you. We score the tone and the accuracy, and flag where the story is off.

Technical accessibility

Can AI crawlers actually read you? Structure, schema, headings, hidden content and indexing settings.

Competitor analysis

You versus your three main competitors, side by side. See who AI recommends instead of you, and why.

Prompt starter sheet

The real questions your buyers ask AI, ready for your team to test and track your visibility month over month.

Top takeaways

A prioritized list of the moves that will improve your AI visibility most, quick wins first.

FAQ

What are AEO and GEO?

Answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) are the work of making your brand easy for AI tools to find, understand, trust and recommend when they generate answers.

Does this replace SEO?

No. GEO builds on SEO. A well-structured site with original, useful content wins on both. The audit shows where your SEO foundation helps you in AI search and where it falls short.

Who is the audit for?

Ambitious brands in a period of change: entering new markets, scaling quickly, or rethinking strategy. If your buyers research before they buy, AI is already part of their shortlist.

What does the audit cost?

The AI Visibility Audit is a one-time investment of $997. You keep every deliverable, and there is no retainer or ongoing commitment. If you want help putting the plan into action, we are happy to talk about that too.
